extracted_information: The document provides information about the CrowdStrike Falcon SDK for Python (FalconPy), including its purpose, features, installation, usage, documentation, support, and contribution guidelines. It highlights the two primary methods for interacting with the CrowdStrike Falcon API using FalconPy: Service Classes and the Uber Class. The document also contains Python examples.
features: Abstracts CrowdStrike Falcon OAuth2 API interaction.
Supports interaction with all CrowdStrike regions.
Supports custom connection and response timeouts.
Supports routing requests through a list of proxies.
Provides Service Classes for each CrowdStrike Falcon API service collection.
Offers an Uber Class for accessing all operations in every API service collection.
Supports cloud region autodiscovery (US-1, US-2, EU-1).
Supports dynamic configuration based upon environment needs.
Supports CrowdStrike Falcon API parameter abstraction.
Supports CrowdStrike Falcon API body payload abstraction (Service Classes only).
